_help: Act 2, the museum reading room: recruiting Eleanor (hired_eleanor). Her fee is up to you (0, 10 or 30); promising her the publication raises trust and conviction. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act2.py.

already.speaker: eleanor
already.line: I've packed my notebooks twice already. Tell me we leave soon.

first.speaker: eleanor
first.line: You're the one asking about Akmentar. I heard every word through the Professor's door.

menu.speaker: eleanor
menu.line: Well? He won't help you. I might.

choices.label: Invite her along
choices.line: Then you heard I need an Egyptologist. Come with us.

choices.label: Ask what she knows
choices.line: What do you know about Akmentar that he doesn't?

choices.label: Doubt her
choices.line: You've never been further than the reading room, have you?

choices.label: Leave
choices.line: Sorry to have bothered you, miss.

knows.speaker: eleanor
knows.line: Three papyri in our own basement name a king who appears on no list. Someone went to a great deal of trouble to forget him. I'd like to know why.

doubt.speaker: eleanor
doubt.line: I've read every account of every expedition that never came back. Which is more than your hired guns have done.

terms.speaker: eleanor
terms.line: Two conditions. Whatever we find, I publish, under my own name. And I am not your secretary.

choices.label: Promise
choices.line: Your name, your work. You have my word.

choices.label: Make no promises
choices.line: Let's find it first, then argue about the credit.

fee.speaker: eleanor
fee.line: The museum pays me ten pounds a month to fetch other people's books. I won't ask you for more than that.

choices.label: Pay her properly
choices.line: Thirty pounds. You'll be doing a scholar's work, not a clerk's.

choices.label: Pay nothing yet
choices.line: You'll get your share when we find it.

joined.speaker: eleanor
joined.line: Then I'm coming. I'll fetch my things before the Professor finds out.

joined_cool.speaker: eleanor
joined_cool.line: Fine. I'm coming anyway. But I'm keeping my own notes.
